decision.rationale: The finite two-reviewer state machine passes complete network-free checks and current metadata validation, so one bounded calibration is the next decision rather than another reviewer search.
limitations: Gemini has not produced any attempt-004 live calibration vote.
Codex is an existing immutable reviewer artifact rather than a new API call.
LLM agreement is silver evidence and does not establish external human ground truth.
The 200-case panel and actual T0 product remain unopened.
